name: FlowKy — sidekick for your coding agent
description: Stream console, errors and network from any page straight into VS Code, plus full-page screenshots and interaction heatmaps.
//host_permissions: Needed by captureVisibleTab, which has no activeTab-only path once the panel drives the capture rather than a click on the page itself.
//content_scripts: Deliberately absent. The recorder and the page collector are injected on demand, so nothing observes a page you did not ask it to.
//connectivity: Two destinations, both explicit. ws://127.0.0.1 for the VS Code bridge (console, errors, network, screenshots) — never leaves the machine. https://flowky.ai ONLY from the account section, and only when you press Save, Report or a checklist tick. No analytics, no telemetry, nothing background.
//cookies: Reads the flowky.ai __session cookie so signing in to the site IS connecting the extension. chrome.cookies can see httpOnly cookies, which page JavaScript cannot. It is exchanged server-side for a scoped, revocable token and never stored; only that token is kept.
